Consulting, Data & Strategy

Consulting, Data & Strategy

Clear decisions based on data — not guesswork.

At TrendMakers, we analyze your business, metrics and funnels to understand what’s working, what isn’t, and what to prioritize next. We turn scattered information into structured insights and strategic action.

Book a call

What do we do in Consulting, Data & Strategy?

We design a data-driven roadmap for growth. That means auditing your funnel, campaigns and performance to build clarity, structure and direction.

  • Audit of data, funnels, campaigns and performance.
  • Definition of strategic KPIs tailored to your model.
  • Actionable dashboards (Looker/Power BI).
  • Insights translated into priorities, actions and recommendations.

From intuition-based decisions to clarity and focus

This service is for you if:

  • You invest in marketing but can’t clearly see what’s working.
  • Your data is spread across tools without consistency.
  • Decisions depend on intuition instead of shared metrics.
  • You can't easily track CAC, LTV, ROAS, churn or profitability.

What’s included in Consulting, Data & Strategy?

We work across four key blocks:

Block 1 – Business & Funnel Diagnosis

  • Acquisition, conversion and retention analysis.
  • Review of channels, campaigns and key touchpoints.
  • Identification of leaks, friction points and opportunities.

Block 2 – KPI & Measurement Framework

  • Definition of key metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, etc.).
  • Event and conversion mapping.
  • Measurement plan aligned with your goals.

Block 3 – Dashboards & Analytics

  • Setup or optimization of dashboards.
  • Integration of marketing, sales and website data.
  • Views for founders, marketing and sales teams.

Block 4 – Strategic Roadmap

  • Prioritization of initiatives.
  • Data-backed recommendations.
  • Clear next steps for execution.
